comments: REPLACE_WITH_REVIEW_COMMENTS. Two points need an explicit answer rather than a silent one. First, TS-ETA-411-008 and TS-ETA-411-009 are planned against destinations that were never navigated - the expectation comes from a link address. Approving them commits the suite to expectations that PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION may contradict; is that acceptable, or should both be deferred until the links have been walked? Second, AMB-ETA-411-006 is still open, so the Preferences page has one planned route while the other two destinations have two. Please confirm that asymmetry is intended for this release rather than leaving it to be corrected by assumption later.

itemDecisions.comment: Successful organization sign-in lands on the Home page. AC-ETA-411-001. Ends at arrival; asserts nothing about Home page content.
Home page presents three activatable icons. AC-ETA-411-002. Inherits the AMB-ETA-411-003 assumption that the set does not vary by user - observed with one account only.
New Transaction icon reaches the New Transaction page. AC-ETA-411-003. The strongest scenario in the plan: asserts both the address and a unique Create Transaction heading.
Workspace icon reaches the Workspace page. AC-ETA-411-004. Address-only assertion - no unique on-screen element exists. Will pass on a page that reached the right address and rendered an error.
Preferences icon reaches the Preferences page. AC-ETA-411-005. Address-only assertion, and the only planned route to this page while AMB-ETA-411-006 is unresolved.
Command Center control returns the user Home. AC-ETA-411-006. Walks all three return legs rather than inferring two from one. Asserts the outcome only, never how the control is labelled.
Header navigation offers New Transaction and Workspace links. AC-ETA-411-007. Deliberately two, not three - no header Preferences link exists.
Header New Transaction link reaches the New Transaction page. AC-ETA-411-008. UNCONFIRMED DESTINATION - taken from the link address, never navigated. See RISK-TP-ETA-411-001.
Header Workspace link reaches the Workspace page. AC-ETA-411-009. UNCONFIRMED DESTINATION - taken from the link address, never navigated. See RISK-TP-ETA-411-001.
